name: Kayama Chigusa
source: [spoiler] Kazuya's true mother. She was raped by her brother, became pregnant, and gave birth to twins Kazuya and Hikari. She took Hikari and raised her as her daughter while her brother took Kazuya and raised him as his son. [/spoiler]
